## Canopy Snow Load Evaluation

@fig-swe-ann-peak shows a subset of Figure 5 from the main manuscript to better illustrate select spring snow events with mixed snow/rain.

![Timeseries of simulated (CP25 and E10) and observed (weighed tree) canopy load at Marmot Creek for select spring snow/rain events between May and June 2019.](figs/supplement/cpy_load_2019_spring_events.png){#fig-swe-ann-peak}

## Subcanopy Snowpack Evaluation

@fig-swe-ann-mean and @fig-swe-ann-peak show the annual mean and max of simulated and observed snow water equivalent. @fig-scatter shows a scatterplot of simulated vs. observed snow water equivalent over all years by each site. 

![Bar chart comparing mean water year snow water equivalent between snow survey observations (OBS) and the two models (CP25 and E10).](figs/final/figure3.png){#fig-swe-ann-mean}

![Bar chart comparing peak water year snow water equivalent between snow survey observations (OBS) and the two models (CP25 and E10).](figs/final/figure4.png){#fig-swe-ann-peak}

![Scatterplot of subcanopy snow water equivalent from observed snow surveys and the two models (CP25 and E10). The solid black line shows a 1:1 line.](figs/supplement/crhm_swe_vs_snow_survey_scatter.png){#fig-scatter}
